description: This is a shell script for testing the disabling of git-over-ssh in clone and fetch operations. It includes setup steps, tests for various repository configurations, and validation of SSH behavior.

methods.name: setup_ssh_wrapper
methods.description: Sets up an SSH wrapper for testing purposes.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit with specified message.

methods.name: test_proto
methods.description: Tests a specific Git protocol URL for SSH.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Executes a test that is expected to succeed.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes a test that is expected to fail.
